title: FlexLine Replacement Relief Timing Share
content:
For replacement relief on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the timing share follows the days from the return date to the latest replacement payment recorded against the return (of two on the same date, the one recorded first): 5 days or fewer give 1.00; more than 5 and no more than 15 days give 0.80; more than 15 days give 0.60.

The share multiplies the replacement relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent. Days are counted in calendar days from the return date to the date of the replacement payment.

| Days from the return date to the latest replacement payment | Share |
|---|---|
| 5 or fewer | 1.00 |
| 6 to 15 | 0.80 |
| more than 15 | 0.60 |

*Hypothetical dates (return on 10 July):* replacement on 15 July is 5 days (1.00); on 16 July, 6 days (0.80); on 25 July, 15 days (0.80); on 26 July, 16 days (0.60). Where two replacements were recorded, the later one is the one dated; a 15.00 USD relief at 0.80 is 12.00 USD before rounding.
